game.title: Assassin's Creed Shadows
game.blurb: Open-world stealth action-adventure set in feudal Japan from Ubisoft, released 2025-03-20. RAWG has no average playtime yet. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Naoe and Yasuke's campaign, from the prologue to the epilogue.

chapters.title: Shinobi and Samurai Skills
chapters.summary: Assassinations, parkour, parries, finishers and mastering both play styles.

chapters.title: The Hideout
chapters.summary: Unlock, build up and decorate your base, and adopt pets.

chapters.title: Exploration and Activities
chapters.summary: Provinces, scouts, kofun, kata, Kuji-kiri, sumi-e, contracts and the tournament.

chapters.title: Claws of Awaji
chapters.summary: The Awaji island expansion: new weapon, targets and sumi-e.

chapters.title: Endgame and Updates
chapters.summary: High levels, Knowledge Rank, golden katana, Corrupted Castles and Templar hunts.
